title: Verify: ContributionSheet dialog behavior unit tests
summary: Test Escape, labelling and closed state
description: Unit tests for the Radix-based sheet with fetch stubbed.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sheet is open, when Escape is pressed, then onClose is called once
Given the sheet is open, then the dialog has the title name, a description and a working Close button
Given open is false, then no dialog is rendered
technical_constraints: Stub fetch with vi.stubGlobal as in tests/contribution.test.tsx; history payload from contributionFixture in tests/fixtures/api.ts, which mirrors the backend contribution response used by GET /api/v1/player/me/contributions

steps.action: Add jsdom header and a stubFetch helper copied from tests/contribution.test.tsx returning 200 with []. Tests: (1) open with onClose=vi.fn(), fireEvent.keyDown(dialog,{key:'Escape'}), expect onClose called once; (2) getByRole('dialog') has accessible name 'Suggest What Happens Next' and description containing 'Ideas are considered when the Round closes.'; (3) open={false} gives queryByRole('dialog') null; (4) clicking the Close button calls onClose; (5) typing in Your idea and clicking Send still posts, proving flows are intact.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionDialog.test.tsx tests/contribution.test.tsx
